a.lede: The iPad Air and iPad Pro are both great options if you plan to use a tablet for work or creativity, but you shouldn't pay for what you won't use.
a.title: iPad Air vs. iPad Pro: The features you're actually paying $450 extra for

b.lede: There's really nothing quite like the iPad Pro out there, but these alternatives show that you can still get great tablets from companies other than Apple.
b.title: 4 iPad Pro alternatives for those looking to ditch Apple
